 Second round of November Social Security payments goes out in four days
 By Mackenzie Chase 
 Published
 November 14, 2026 6:00am ET
 Advertisement -->
 Advertisement 
 Add Washington Examiner on Google
 Advertisement 
 The second round of November Social Security payments for retirees, now capped at $5,181, will be issued in four days.
 When will payments arrive?
 The second round will go out on Wednesday, Nov. 18, to those born between the 11th and 20th of a month.
